decisions.reason: Compared exact native original pixels and actual returned master. The original upper-lip moustache is fine and visibly grey/light at the sides, with a small darker centre. The return makes it a dense uniformly black broad patch. Restore the exact source grey/light side hairs, dark central distribution, thinner density, tapered footprint and placement from image2; do not erase the genuine moustache or add chin hair. Preserve all unrelated actual combed dark hair, round dark glasses, smooth chin, brown jacket, pale shirt/dark tie, source pose/lighting/crop and restored opaque backdrop.
